about: A tool that writes documentation for a database, made to run in CI.

prs.title: SQLite docs show a multi-column primary key once
prs.broken: For SQLite, a primary key made of two columns was listed three times: once per column and once for the real key. That wrongly said each column alone was a key.
prs.changed: The docs now list the real key once, over all its columns.
prs.matters: The generated docs describe the database correctly instead of misleading readers.
